user.title: Woningwaarde
user.description: Choose a region and house type. National house-type growth is adjusted by regional growth relative to the Netherlands. This is a combined estimate, not a separate regional house-type index.Date calculation anchors a quarter index at the first day after that quarter and interpolates linearly. After the last publication it extends the last quarter trend for up to four months. This is a forecast. The old quarter method remains available separately.
